WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.sentreg, 
    s.instownpct, 
    t.ordertypedist 
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s 
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg 
  WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist, 
    AVG(instownpct) as mix_baseline
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg 
  FROM joined_data
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT 
    jd.instownpct, 
    mb.mix_baseline,
    (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average) as overall_avg
  FROM joined_data jd
  JOIN mix_baselines mb ON jd.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
  WHERE jd.instownpct > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership_kept,
  AVG(instownpct / mix_baseline) as avg_relative_to_mix,
  AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) as avg_excess_above_overall
FROM kept_units
